instruction:
Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Implement a pipelined module that takes in a 4-bit binary number and outputs the same vector, 
as well as three separate 1-bit outputs that correspond to the most significant bit (MSB), the middle bit, and the least significant bit (LSB) of the input vector. 
The module must use a combination of a pipelined carry lookahead adder and a multiplexer to achieve the required functionality.
